description: Quebec employee -- routes through Revenu Quebec's own provincial module (not the generic provincial bracket path) plus QPP (replaces CPP) and QPIP (replaces EI), at $6,000/month. federal_income_tax/state_income_tax updated 2026-09-11 (gap-closure Phase 1): the CRA-correct credit method (now default) switches BOTH federal BPA/CEA AND Quebec's own quebec_bpa to a credit at each jurisdiction's own lowest rate (canada.py's _calculate_quebec_provincial_tax gates on the same _CA_CREDIT_METHOD_ENABLED_COUNTRIES switch as federal/generic-provincial) -- worker_deduction stays a genuine income deduction either way.
